title.narrative: NESA Center RJNDC "Perspectives on Strategy for Senior Leadership" 01-25

description.narrative: Objective: In fulfillment of the theater security cooperation objectives of USCENTCOM and in support of the Office of the Secretary of Defense for Policy (OSD-P), NESA is deepening a long-standing relationship with professional military education institutions in Jordan. This course of instruction provided to the Academic Year 2024-2025 class attending the Royal Jordanian National Defense College, is intended to provide an overview of Strategic Leadership, Strategic Planning, Organizational Change Management, and failures in Strategies to faculty and students. The program is further intended to expose faculty members to best practices in delivering professional military education. This program is in fulfillment of a Memorandum of Understanding that was approved by Jordans Ministry of Defense. Planning for a follow on delivery of subject matter expertise presentations proposed for January/February 2025 will be reviewed as part of the visit. Initial program planning for Academic Year 2025-2026 will also be discussed upon during the visit.

title.narrative: Proliferation Security Initiative - Exercise Eager Lion

description.narrative: The Proliferation Security Initiative (PSI) is an international cooperative effort to stop trafficking in Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD), their delivery systems, and related materials to and from state and non-state actors of proliferation concern. DoD is the U.S. Governments operational lead for the PSI and works closely with other departments/agencies to conduct and participate in PSI exercises, workshops, training events, meetings and other activities. These activities demonstrate the commitment of participants to the PSI Statement of Interdiction Principles, test national capabilities to conduct air, ground, and maritime interdictions and increase understanding of PSI globally and within geographic regions.
